column2: Security Education Scheme of Work for Primary/Basic 1
column3: Security Education Scheme of Work for Primary/Basic 1
By the end of the lesson; pupils should be able to: i. define the meaning of security; ii. describe how a security personnel looks like.
By the end of the lesson; pupils should be able to: i. mention security facts e.g. do not take anything from a stranger. ii. do not follow a stranger e.t.c.; iii. discuss strangers tactics.
By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able: i. mention sources of insecurity. e.g -A dilapidated building -Filling station with no fire extinguisher.
By the end of the lesson; pupils should i. explain the security alert signs ii. list and discuss the consequences of neglecting signs of security alert
By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. mention the security colours and meaning e.g Red, yellow, Blue, Green and Orange. ii. discuss the meaning of colours.
By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. List security gadget e.g. Camera, CCTV, microphone.
By the end of the lesson pupil should be able to: (l) mention home security tips e.g. Locking the doors, Flood light, detector e.t.c
By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. mention the security measures to be taken in offices e.g locking doors, putting all electrical appliances off.
By the end of the lesson; pupils should be able to : i. define personal security, ii. list components of personal security at home, school, on the road etc
